run_a2c_training: run the A2C reinforcement learning training loop for CartPole-v0 using moolib distributed training
build_Model_class: build a PyTorch model with linear layers and optional LSTM for policy and baseline output
create_a2c_loss: create the A2C loss function computing policy gradient, baseline, and entropy losses from rollout data
review_train_function: review the train function that orchestrates environment interaction, gradient computation, and distributed reduction
summarize_log_to_file: summarize the log_to_file function that incrementally writes training metrics to a TSV file
